name: SUNCON
recent: Sunway Construction 近期获得两份大型数据中心合约，总值约 RM1.74b 及 US$657m，同时雇员公积金局（EPF）持续申报股权变动。公司也因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股。
notable: 获得价值 RM1.74b 的雪兰莪超大规模数据中心建筑合约。
获得价值 US$657m 的雪兰莪和柔佛数据中心工程。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在多个交易日申报股权变动。
risks: 公司因 ESOS 行使而持续发行新股，可能造成股权轻微摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 RM1,017.7m，环比下降0.5%，同比下降31.1%；净利为 RM103.6m，环比下降12.5%，同比增长23.5%；净利率为10.2%，低于上一季度的11.6%。

recent_en: Sunway Construction recently secured two major data centre contracts worth approximately RM1.74b and US$657m, while the Employees Provident Fund Board continued to file changes in its shareholding. The company also issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises.
notable_en: Secured a RM1.74b hyperscale data centre construction contract in Selangor.
Won US$657m worth of data centre jobs in Selangor and Johor.
Employees Provident Fund Board filed changes in its shareholding on multiple trading days.
risks_en: CGS International suggested the company should diversify away from data centres.
The company continues to issue new shares under ESOS, which may cause slight equity dilution.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,017.7m, down 0.5% QoQ and 31.1% YoY; net income was RM103.6m, down 12.5% QoQ but up 23.5% YoY; net margin was 10.2%, lower than 11.6% in the previous quarter.
